item.title: Matt Damon and Noah Kahan on ‘SNL’: How to Watch the Sketch Comedy TV Series Live Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest updates on your favorite shows and events. This Saturday, get ready to tune in to a brand new episode of Saturday Night Live, with Matt Damon as the host and Noah Kahan as the musical guest. This will be Damon's third time hosting and Kahan's second performance on the show."
[Short music transition]
Host: "If you want to catch the episode live, SNL will be broadcasting on NBC and livestreaming on Peacock Premium at 11:30 p.m. ET/8:30 p.m. PT. But don't worry if you don't have cable - there are plenty of ways to stream SNL online for free. You can sign up for a free trial with DirecTV, which gives you access to NBC and other live TV channels. Alternatively, you can subscribe to Sling Blue, Peacock Premium, or Hulu + Live TV, which all offer NBC and other great channels."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Matt Damon is promoting his new film, The Odyssey, directed by Christopher Nolan, which comes out in theaters on July 17. And Noah Kahan just dropped his latest album, The Great Divide, in January and is set to go on tour in North America starting June 11. Make sure to catch them on SNL this Saturday, and we'll see you next time on our podcast!"
[Outro music plays]
